meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 对比当前代码与 npm 上最新发布版本，按三个发布层分类列出所有未发布变更，并给出各层版本升级建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“unpublished changes”、“changelog”、“what changed”等关键词，或要求查看未发布更改时触发。

say.text: 对比 HEAD 和最新 npm 版本，列出所有未发布变更。
say.note: 技能会立即分析并输出分层结果。

say.text: 按发布层生成 changelog，注明每个变更的影响。
say.note: 会得到 feat/fix/refactor 分类和版本建议。

say.text: 检查有哪些 what's new 内容，并给出版本更新建议。
say.note: Claude 会比较已发布版本并报告。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude compare the current HEAD with the latest published npm versions, list all unpublished changes by release layer, and recommend version bumps per layer.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords such as 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', or 'what changed', or when you ask to review unpublished changes.

say_en.text: Compare HEAD with the latest npm version and list all unpublished changes.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze diffs and output layered results.

say_en.text: Generate a changelog grouped by release layer.
say_en.note: You'll get feat/fix/refactor categories and version recommendations.

say_en.text: Check what's new and suggest version bumps.
say_en.note: Claude compares against published versions and reports.
